# SkuTier

The plans. Enterprise is not sold through the price list; it is set up by agreement.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Free"` | The free plan. |
| `"Dev"` | The Dev plan. |
| `"Builder"` | The Builder plan. |
| `"Team"` | The Team plan. |
| `"Scale"` | The Scale plan. |
| `"Enterprise"` | The Enterprise plan, set up by agreement. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.
